subject: Hidden payout field blocking PO payment setup — MeridianWorks
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@meridianworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Payout / bank info field missing on supplier portal - can't set up PO payments

Hi Ben / Laura,

We're onboarding several suppliers today and Accounts Payable ran into an issue: when a supplier follows the Coupa invite and completes the company profile the "Payout account / Bank routing" section is not visible for their admin users. Without that field AP can't record bank details and POs remain stuck in 'Awaiting Payment Setup'.

I've attached a screenshot of what the supplier sees and the AP checklist we were following. This is blocking two live POs scheduled for this week (PO# MW-2238 / MW-2239). Can you confirm whether this is a tenant-level attribute or if it's being hidden by our SSO mapping?

Quick details:
- Supplier: Northpoint Fabrication (merchant id: MF-9981)
- Portal: Coupa (tenant meridianworks.prod)
- First seen: 2027-06-30 07:30 PT

Appreciate a fast look — AP is asking for a manual workaround if this will take >4 hours.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
MeridianWorks — Accounts Payable

Attachment: Meridian_AP_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@meridianworks.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payout / bank info field missing on supplier portal - can't set up PO payments

Folks — quick update after looking at tenant config and a repro.

What I did: created a test supplier in MeridianWorks tenant (Northpoint repro), completed profile via Coupa invite flow. Confirmed the bank/payout section is conditionally rendered based on the supplier_capabilities attribute that our backend sets from the SAML attribute 'x-supplier-cap'. In this tenant that attribute is coming through as an empty string for invitee accounts created by Meridian's IdP.

Evidence: reproduced UI + captured response from the /api/suppliers/{id}/schema endpoint (screenshot attached).

Immediate options:
1) Workaround (recommended short-term): set supplier_capabilities=true on the tenant level for meridianworks.prod. This will surface the payout fields for all newly invited suppliers. Requires tenant admin toggle; I can apply it and test.
2) Root fix (longer): Meridian IdP needs to send the x-supplier-cap SAML attribute on assertion. Karthik / Platform team will need to add a fallback mapping for cases when attribute is blank so we default to enabling bank fields for invite flows.

Impact: if we enable the tenant-level toggle we can clear the two blocked POs within ~30 minutes (we'll still need suppliers to enter bank details). If we wait for the IdP fix it will take ~2-3 days (Meridian's SSO team must change assertions and we need a canary rollout).

Next steps I propose:
- Ben: confirm we should apply tenant-level override now (I can do it and notify you when done).
- Sanjay: if you approve, ask AP to hold off on manual ACH requests until we enable the flag so entries remain in the portal audit trail.
- Karthik: please review for a small platform fallback to treat blank x-supplier-cap as 'capable' for invite-time rendering.

Attachment: tenant_schema_capture.png (image/png)

Rachel Kim
Payments & Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Payout / bank info field missing on supplier portal - can't set up PO payments

Thanks Rachel — please go ahead and flip the tenant-level override for MeridianWorks. Sanjay, please confirm AP can wait ~30 minutes after I get confirmation and we'll ask suppliers to re-open their profile and add bank details.

Karthik — can you create SUP-4234 (or use the draft link Rachel included) and assign to Platform with a medium priority fallback to land a default for empty SAML attributes? If you can estimate the effort I will include that in the postmortem for MeridianWorks.

Sanjay — appreciate the patience. Once Rachel confirms I've instructed AP to pause manual ACHs and wait for portal entry so payments have traceable audit metadata. If AP cannot wait, confirm and we'll provide a short-term template for a payment request entry.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
